liam_partnerships: Quick sync — finalizing Marketplace launch readiness with NorthStar Cloud + HawkHardware. Need confirmations on press embargo, landing page live copy, SI integration runbook, and hardware image bake timeline. Proposed timeline: staging QA by Tue 11:00 PT (2629990000), press embargo lift Wed 09:00 PT, public announce Wed 12:00 PT. Upload final assets to drive: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/launch-assets :eyes:

sarah_marketing: Ack. Are we firm on Wed 12:00 for public? Need 24h journalist outreach window. We should keep embargo until 12:00 PT and send embargo emails at 09:00 PT. I'll draft embargo note today.

maria_pm: Who owns the SI runbook? Need checklist: connector install steps, sample terraform, smoke tests, rollback steps. I can own authoring but need CI owner + SI contact.

dan_engineer: From infra side: billing connector is green, but SAML SSO for Marketplace console needs extra claims mapping (ok with NorthStar, still waiting on their ACS URL). Also we need to verify image compatibility for HawkHardware (quantized runtime). ETA for engineers: tomorrow EOD.

oliver_prod: Landing page: final hero copy v3 attached in drive. CTA should be 'Try on Redwood Marketplace' with marketplace param ?partner=hawk. Also add telemetry snippet:
```
fetch('/api/track', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({event:'marketplace_click', partner:'hawk'})})
```
Make sure marketing and analytics sign off.

liam_partnerships: Maria/Oliver/Sarah — owners noted. Maria please publish SI runbook PR by EOD tomorrow. Sarah to send embargo email draft today. Dan to confirm ACS URL by 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll coordinate with NorthStar and HawkHW.

sarah_marketing: Will include press kit (logos, exec quotes, 2 screenshots). Need legal signoff on quote — @oliver_prod can you ping legal? :pray: 

oliver_prod: Yep pinged legal via email. legal replied 'reviewed, minor edit to Hawk quote'. I'll push final assets by tonight.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging cutover prep window starts 2629992000 (Tue 02:00 PT). Please tag deploy playbook in PRs.

liam_partnerships: One more — can we confirm the marketplace SKU mapping for HawkHardware? Dan, if you can paste the SKU table here that'd help partner ops.

dan_engineer: SKU mapping draft:
- hawk-small -> 4xA10G
- hawk-medium -> 8xA10G
- hawk-large -> 16xA100q
I'll push to drive and ping partner ops.

maria_pm: Adding acceptance criteria to runbook: 1) end-to-end deploy on staging, 2) SAML SSO smoke login, 3) Marketplace buy flow with test card, 4) telemetry firing for CTA clicks. If everyone OK I'll open the PR.

sarah_marketing: OK from marketing. I'll coordinate press list and embargo emails after final quote.

liam_partnerships: Great — final owners/duedates: Maria (SI runbook PR) — 2629990400; Dan (ACS URL + SKU final) — 2629990800; Oliver (legal final assets) — 2629990000; Sarah (embargo emails) — 2629992000. If no major blockers, we keep Wed announce. :rocket:

oliver_prod: +1 :rocket:

dan_engineer: On it.
